source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Mesh Topology' (PDF 11): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: Mesh topology mein devices bohat se doosre devices se jure hote hain. Data bhejne ke liye kai raaste (multiple paths) hote hain. Is se reliability (bharosa) aur fault tolerance (kharabi ke bawajood chalte rehna) barhti hai. Ek link fail ho to baat-cheet nahi rukti. Mesh topology mehngi aur complex (pecheeda) hai. Yeh bare aur critical (bohat ahem, jaise bank ya hospital ke) networks mein istemal hoti hai.

Figure 1.11 mesh topology wala network dikhati hai. Is topology mein har device bohat se doosre devices se jura hai. Data apni destination (manzil) tak kai raaston se ja sakta hai. Agar ek connection toot jaye to data doosra raasta le leta hai. Yeh figure samjhati hai ke mesh topology bohat reliable (qabil-e-bharosa) magar complex kyun hai.

blocks.alt: Mesh topology: paanch devices (Wi-Fi nishan wala globe, do desktop computers, laptop aur printer), har aik alag lakeer se baqi har device se jura hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.11: Mesh topology (kitab ki Figure 1.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Full mesh mein n devices hon to har device baqi (n - 1) se jurta hai, is liye kul links n x (n - 1) / 2 hote hain. 5 devices ke liye 5 x 4 / 2 = 10 cables. Isi liye mesh mehngi hai.

blocks.prompt: Mesh topology sab se zyada reliable kyun hai, aur phir bhi har jagah kyun nahi lagti?
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke data ke kai raaste hain; ek link toot jaye to data doosre raaste se chala jata hai. Lekin is mein bohat cables lagti hain, is liye yeh mehngi aur complex hai.

items: Mesh: har device kai devices se, kai raaste; bohat reliable aur fault-tolerant; mehngi aur complex; critical networks.
